contract.task_clause:
A proton enters a solenoid. Upon entry, the proton is moving in a straight line along the axis of the solenoid. Which of the following is a correct description of the proton’s motion within the solenoid?
Option A: The proton will be bent in a parabolic path.
Option B: The proton will be bent in a circular path.
Option C: The proton will continue in its straight path at constant velocity.
Option D: The proton will continue in its straight path and slow down.
